title: Formalize Software Factory worktree/branch naming and file-scope lock-check tooling
summary: Phase 3b proved copy-mode isolated parallel builders with manual exact-copy integration. The next maturation step is reusable worktree/branch naming and file-scope lock-check tooling before larger scale-up.

body.scope: Delivery-owned tooling/specification only; formalize naming conventions and a validator/helper for declared file-scope locks before using larger parallel builder lanes.
hard_constraints: explicit owner approval required before execution
body.close_when: A validated spec/helper exists for worktree/branch naming and file-scope lock checking, with expected-fail fixtures for overlapping scopes.

proposed_action: After owner approval, build a small reusable worktree/branch naming and file-scope lock-check helper/spec for Software Factory parallel builders.
requested_action: After owner approval, build a small reusable worktree/branch naming and file-scope lock-check helper/spec for Software Factory parallel builders.
success_signal: Future parallel builder runs can fail closed before dispatch when file scopes overlap or naming/isolation evidence is missing.
